properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Can be used via Hugging Face `transformers`, `vLLM` or `SGLang`; vLLM and SGLang servers are started with a reasoning parser and queried via an OpenAI-compatible client; the model generates think content wrapped in a `<think>...</think>` block followed by the final response; recommended temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, max new tokens up to 65536.

modelParameters.modelArchitecture: Causal decoder-only model with a hybrid architecture (Transformers + Mamba2), built on Falcon-H1-7B-Base. The card does not state layers, attention type, experts, active parameters or rationale.

performanceMetrics.value: Falcon-H1R-7B scores: AIME24 88.1, AIME25 83.1, HMMT25 64.9, AMO-BENCH 36.3, MATH500 97.4, LCBv5-v6 68.6, GPQA-D 61.3, MMLU-Pro 72.1, HLE 11.1, IFBench 53.4, Terminal-Bench Hard 4.9. With test-time scaling (DeepConf): AIME24 96.7, AIME25 96.7, GPQA-D 70.2, AMO-Bench* 35.9.

technicalLimitations: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It mentions only one failure mode: endless repetitions, which can be reduced by adjusting the repetition_penalty and presence_penalty parameters in supported frameworks.

properties.value: Test-time scaling (TTS) results on a few benchmarks were evaluated via DeepConf; AMO-Bench* is limited to the parser-verifiable subset of 39 problems. Recommended sampling: temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, max new tokens up to 65536.
